messages:
Maya: Heads up — console is spiking from the aggregate-slice rehydration job this morning. It's consuming tenant credits and the dashboard panels are very noisy. Can we pause or reroute mid-run? cc @Kevin @Sam
Kevin: Which run id? I see a `rehydrate-v3` kicked off at 07:12 that kept retrying on 503s. It climbed past the quota throttle and started flooding the retry queue.
Sam: Got it. That one was the slice-granularity pilot. We expected some retries but not this rash of parallel resends.
Irene: Quick note — console shows the job as "Running (unpaused)" but the per-tenant quota UI doesn't expose the currently-allocated credits, only historical. Ops can't tell if kills will free buckets. UX gap.
deploy-bot: Pipeline: rehydrate-v3 triggered by Maya. run_id=run-20260309-07-12. Status: running.
Maya: run-20260309-07-12 is the one. Two asks: (1) can we move remaining slices to low-priority routing lane so it doesn't affect realtime tenants? (2) can we toggle a dry-run / no-write mode for future runs?
Kevin: For (1) we can set routing policy to route to the 'best-effort' pool by tag `priority=low` but that pool is smaller — will increase completion time. For (2) the rehydrate API currently lacks `dry_run`. We can patch endpoint to accept `?preview=true` quickly.
Sam: Suggestion: kill the big run, re-enqueue split jobs with slice window size = 5m instead of 1h, and route them to low-priority. Smaller slices are cheaper and retry blast radius is smaller.
Irene: Agree on splits. Also asking product: console should show "credits at risk" per job + a one-click reroute to low-priority. Right now engineers keep guessing.
Maya: Ops permission: are we OK to kill run-20260309-07-12 now and reschedule? 
OpsRunner: I'll hold for 2m for any dev objections. Killing will free tenant quotas immediately.
Sam: No objections. I will open the requeue job with the smaller slice size and `priority=low`. Also adding `dedupe_window=30s` to prevent duplicate writes.
Kevin: I'll push a tiny API patch that accepts `preview=true` and returns estimated token/credit use per slice. Will be a short-lived flag but helpful for console preflight estimates.
Irene: Can we also ensure the console preflight uses the same estimator as the runtime? Last time numbers diverged which led to bad decisions.
Maya: Noted — please sync estimator code. Sam/Kevin, assign a PR and ping infra for quota checks.
deploy-bot: Action: kill-request queued by OpsRunner for run-20260309-07-12.
OpsRunner: Done — run terminated. Freeing quotas now.
Sam: Requeue created: run-20260309-11-30-split-5m-priority-low. Added `dry_preview=true` flag for initial dry-run checks.
Kevin: API patch submitted: PR #4127 includes `preview=true` and per-slice cost estimates. Leaving comments about edge cases (sharded aggregates, kv-cache priming).
Irene: Filed UX ticket: REHYDRATE-601 "Console preflight: per-job credit exposure + reroute button". Linking PR when ready.
Maya: Thanks all. Summary: killed noisy run, requeued split low-priority runs, API preview flag in flight, UX ticket created. Can we follow up on SLA impact later today?
Sam: I'll watch the new runs and post a short postmortem tomorrow if anything else pops. :thumbsup:
Kevin: I'll coordinate with infra to validate estimator parity.
Irene: I'll prototype the reroute button mock and attach screenshots to REHYDRATE-601.
Maya: Perfect. Closing the loop for now — please post any anomalies in this thread so we have a single timeline.
